protocol:
Transformation of supercompetent cells
Inoculate two separate 1.5mls of LB medium with Invitrogen (InvαF') cells.
Also include an uninoculated negative control tube.
Shake at 250 rpm overnight at 37˚C.
Inoculate with 500ul of overnight E. coli culture two 50ml tubes each containing 25mls of sterile SOB media.
Shake at 250 rpm for 4 hours. 
Ice the tubes of cells for 15 mins. 
Pellet cells (approx 5 min spin, approx 3000 rpm) and discard supernatant. 
Resuspend each pellet of cells in 8 mls of cold TFB by washing gently, then sucking up and down, with a wide-bore 10ml pipette tip. 
Ice the tubes of cells for 15 mins. 
Pellet cells (approx 5 min spin, approx 3000 rpm) and discard supernatant. 
Resuspend one pellet of cells in 2 mls of cold TFB and use this liquid to resuspend the second pellet.
You should now have all cells in a single aliquot of 2mls cold TFB.
Add 105ul of DMSO swirl and ice for 5 mins.
Add 80ul of 100mM DTT, swirl, and ice for 10 mins.
Add 105ul of DMSO swirl and ice for 5 mins.
Aliquot 180ul of cells into pre-chilled, labelled 5ml polypropylene growth tubes with loose-cap lids.
Include positive and negative controls.
Add ligation DNA to each sample (in ~10ul volume) and ice for 30 mins. 
Heat pulse tubes at exactly 42˚C for exactly 90 secs.
Ice for 2 mins. 
Add 400ul of 37˚C SOC to each tube and incubate at 37˚C for 10 mins. 
Incubate a further 45 mins at 37˚C shaking at 225 rpm. 
Place tubes in ice to halt growth. 
Transfer the cells from each tube to a labelled individual 1.5ml microfuge tube. 
Give the microfuge tubes a very short (5 sec) spin to very loosely pellet the cells and then remove and discard 370ul of the supernatant. 
Plate 40ul of the cell solution onto LB/ Amp+/ Xgal plates and grow overnight at 37˚C

# MANUAL: include (container: 1.5ml tube, reagent: LB medium (uninoculated), volume: 1.5ml, other: {'control_type': 'negative'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
shake(container='1.5ml tube', temperature='37˚C', duration='overnight', speed='250 rpm')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: inoculate (container: 50ml tube, reagent: overnight E. coli culture, volume: 500ul, other: {'number_of_tubes': 2, 'media': '25ml sterile SOB'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
shake(container='50ml tube', duration='4 hours', speed='250 rpm')
cool(container='50ml tube', reagent='cells', temperature='on ice', duration='15 mins')
centrifuge(container='50ml tube', reagent='cells', duration='5 min', speed='3000 rpm', purpose='pellet cells')
discard(container='50ml tube', reagent='supernatant')
resuspend(container='50ml tube', reagent='cold TFB', volume='8ml', temperature='cold', method='wash gently, then pipette up and down with wide-bore 10ml tip')
cool(container='50ml tube', reagent='cells', temperature='on ice', duration='15 mins')
centrifuge(container='50ml tube', reagent='cells', duration='5 min', speed='3000 rpm', purpose='pellet cells')
discard(container='50ml tube', reagent='supernatant')
resuspend(container='50ml tube', reagent='cold TFB', volume='2ml', temperature='cold', method='use this liquid to resuspend second pellet')
add(container='single aliquot (2ml cold TFB)', reagent='DMSO', volume='105ul', mix_method='swirl')
cool(container='single aliquot (2ml cold TFB)', temperature='on ice', duration='5 mins')
add(container='single aliquot (2ml cold TFB)', reagent='100mM DTT', volume='80ul', mix_method='swirl')
cool(container='single aliquot (2ml cold TFB)', temperature='on ice', duration='10 mins')
add(container='single aliquot (2ml cold TFB)', reagent='DMSO', volume='105ul', mix_method='swirl')
cool(container='single aliquot (2ml cold TFB)', temperature='on ice', duration='5 mins')
aliquot(container='5ml polypropylene growth tube (pre-chilled, labelled, loose-cap lid)', reagent='cells in cold TFB', volume='180ul', temperature='cold')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: include (container: 5ml polypropylene growth tube, reagent: positive and negative controls)

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
add(container='5ml polypropylene growth tube', reagent='ligation DNA', volume='10ul')
cool(container='5ml polypropylene growth tube', temperature='on ice', duration='30 mins')
heat(container='5ml polypropylene growth tube', temperature='42˚C', duration='90 secs', method='heat pulse')
cool(container='5ml polypropylene growth tube', temperature='on ice', duration='2 mins')
add(container='5ml polypropylene growth tube', reagent='SOC', volume='400ul', temperature='37˚C')
incubate(container='5ml polypropylene growth tube', temperature='37˚C', duration='10 mins')
incubate(container='5ml polypropylene growth tube', temperature='37˚C', duration='45 mins', speed='225 rpm')
cool(container='5ml polypropylene growth tube', temperature='on ice', purpose='halt growth')
transfer(container='1.5ml microfuge tube (labelled, individual)', reagent='cells', from='5ml polypropylene growth tube')
centrifuge(container='1.5ml microfuge tube', reagent='cells', duration='5 sec', purpose='loosely pellet cells')
discard(container='1.5ml microfuge tube', reagent='supernatant', volume='370ul')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: plate (container: LB/Amp+/Xgal plate, reagent: cell solution, volume: 40ul)

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='LB/Amp+/Xgal plate', temperature='37˚C', duration='overnight')
